scope: M1 declared item-spawn contact at occupied source scenery

source_basis.pot_reference_fact: The frozen page identifies item-spawn pots on counters/tables, including the ground-floor Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
source_basis.rule_fact: These source routes require reachable ordinary pickup; they do not require occupying an impassable counter tile.
source_basis.qualification: Source-supported minimal contact using the existing cardinal near-face primitive, not a newly observed universal OSRS ground-item pickup radius.

unchanged_source_targets.qualification: The target has north/east sight barriers. Only the clear south face is selected; sight19 is not treated as an entirely open tile.

admission: Actual ground identity exists uniquely and passes unchanged owner/publicity/expiry/source-policy rules.
Actor and item belong to the same plane and live instance.
Exact-tile pickup remains the ordinary path, including all eight currently walkable source spawns.
A non-exact contact additionally requires an engine-issued source-spawn identity, its declared item stack, and exact mapped source/entity location.
The target cell must be nonwalkable with full movement occupancy255, and the actor must occupy a walkable cardinal neighbour at distance1.
Approach movement and both directional sight edges must be clear. The contact never clears collision, crosses a diagonal corner or treats an opaque target as transparent.
The same ground_access function governs the read-only can_take projection and actual pickup. Inventory transfer and source respawn remain unchanged.
The journey planner derives only these conservative source goals, then requires a fresh authoritative permission on the same observed ground ID/stack/tile before sending pickup.
not_changed: Ground item positions, collision cells, object transforms and original source files
Walkability, source clocks, RNG, ownership, inventory limits or reward/progression rules

Source5e protected account/checkpoints, its consumed db74895 authority or current source5b artifact
